description: This file defines the GrainCollectionOptions class, which contains configuration settings for idle grain collection within the Orleans Runtime. It includes properties for collection timing, activation/deactivation timeouts, and memory pressure shedding options.

classes.name: GrainCollectionOptions
classes.description: A class encapsulating options related to grain collection, including timing, memory pressure, and aging settings.
